objective: Refresh the bounded DR24 epoch-payload probe on the current main baseline without changing production normalization, model artifacts, or scientific acceptance criteria.
previous_knowledge_consumed: DR24 Objects Table HATS acquisition succeeded for a deterministic 150-object sample; this does not prove epoch-payload retrieval.
PR #255 contains an earlier bounded probe implementation but is stale relative to the current main workflow registration.
The default branch now contains a manual-only DR24 payload-probe workflow.
The bounded source probe is executed only from its isolated investigation branch or by manual dispatch; no full-catalog scan is part of this workflow.

baseline.description: Current main contains the manual-only DR24 payload workflow. The refreshed probe is isolated on a dedicated investigation branch.

expected_improvement: Provide a bounded, reproducible source probe for raw DR24 epoch payloads.
Record source identifiers, field mapping, row counts, dtypes, finite-value summaries, and SHA-256 evidence.
Keep live payload evidence separate from model features and frozen scientific benchmarks.

reproducibility.reason: The manual source-backed probe has not yet been dispatched.

scientific_validity.reason: The probe is an acquisition/mapping experiment, not a benchmark validation.

coverage.reason: No live epoch payload artifact has yet been collected or reviewed.

measurement.trade_off: The probe is limited to at most five explicitly supplied OIDs. It does not establish full-catalog coverage or production compatibility.

evidence: CI must validate formatting, lint, lifecycle schema, tests, smoke tests, package build, and dependency audit.
CodeQL and Product Scope Audit must pass.
A branch-scoped push run or manual workflow_dispatch run must produce a source-backed payload artifact before epoch-field availability can be claimed.

root_causes: The first PR-triggered CI attempt failed the cumulative lifecycle gate because the refreshed probe files did not include a cycle record under configs/process/cycles/.
The failure is a process-record requirement, not evidence of a defect in the DR24 payload parser.
The first lifecycle-record correction used an unsupported metric name (source_coverage) and an unsupported regression status (PENDING); the validator permits coverage and NOT_VERIFIED.

findings: A successful Objects Table catalog query is distinct from successful epoch-level Lightcurves payload acquisition.
Contract tests do not establish live-source availability.
Raw source fields must remain unmodified until their semantics and units are verified.

open_blockers: The refreshed probe and cumulative lifecycle record must pass the full PR CI gate.
The bounded branch-scoped workflow must complete and its payload manifest and artifact inspected.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not modify the v0.2.0 model, 42-feature schema, class order, or historical cutoff as part of this source probe.
Do not claim DR24 epoch payload support until the live artifact is verified.
